resources.string: Choose the newest decoded frame on this device when several are ready. May reduce lag under load. Desktop capture and encoding still run on the computer.

ADB: Enable USB debugging, accept the computer authorization prompt, and turn on Extra Display on the PC. The PC opens and refreshes this app automatically.

USB accessory: Select USB accessory (AOA) in USB Connection on your computer. Connect a data cable and open Extraspace from Android’s USB prompt. USB debugging is optional.

Your device ID lets the PC remember display position, GNOME scale and Extraspace settings. Reinstalling or clearing app data creates a new ID. Use Android Back to open this screen during streaming.
